schema_note: One entry per suspicion-score method, keyed by method id. Each entry names its own score in "score"; api._load_method_cutoffs ignores an entry whose score does not match its key.

s_att.score_description: Computed score S_att (first method tried): attention-weighted mean absolute gap, in rating points, between the rating model's per-move estimate and the side's baseline. No trained parameters.
s_att.source_description: Stratified sample of held-out TEST-partition games from the thesis corpus (analysis/heldout_test_eval/attn_tuned__best.csv on the HPC checkout; seed 20260915; up to 700 games each for bullet, blitz and rapid, every available classical and ultrabullet game; months with unpacked game files only; at least 20 plies): the same 2822 games (5644 sides) for all four methods, reused from the per-move detector's cutoffs run rather than re-sampled. Scored on CPU with the prototype's own code and the frozen rating checkpoint, each side as the suspect against its PGN-header rating. The rating model never trained on these games, and the trained detectors trained only on synthetic games.
s_att.note: These cutoffs describe how S_att is distributed across ordinary, finished, rated human games in the held-out test set. They are not a cheat-detection threshold: S_att separated engine-substituted synthetic games at about chance (ROC-AUC about 0.51 on rating bands withheld from training).

lgbm_a0g.score_description: Trained LightGBM detector (thesis arm A0g): game-level output in [0, 1] per side from 97 pooled per-game features.
lgbm_a0g.source_description: Stratified sample of held-out TEST-partition games from the thesis corpus (analysis/heldout_test_eval/attn_tuned__best.csv on the HPC checkout; seed 20260915; up to 700 games each for bullet, blitz and rapid, every available classical and ultrabullet game; months with unpacked game files only; at least 20 plies): the same 2822 games (5644 sides) for all four methods, reused from the per-move detector's cutoffs run rather than re-sampled. Scored on CPU with the prototype's own code and the frozen rating checkpoint, each side as the suspect against its PGN-header rating. The rating model never trained on these games, and the trained detectors trained only on synthetic games.
lgbm_a0g.note: These cutoffs describe how the LightGBM detector score is distributed across ordinary, finished, rated human games in the held-out test set. They are not a cheat-detection threshold: on synthetic games from rating bands withheld from training it reached ROC-AUC about 0.69, and about 0.54 and 0.57 when 2 and 5 percent of moves were engine moves.

detector_a3g_seed0.source_description: Stratified sample of held-out TEST-partition games from the thesis corpus (analysis/heldout_test_eval/attn_tuned__best.csv on the HPC checkout; seed 20260915; up to 700 games each for bullet, blitz and rapid, every available classical and ultrabullet game; months with unpacked game files only; at least 20 plies): the same 2822 games (5644 sides) for all four methods, reused from the per-move detector's cutoffs run rather than re-sampled.
